en.name: Sailor
en.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.

zh.name: 水手
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择一名存活的玩家：你或他之一会醉酒直到下个黄昏。你不会死亡。
